description: The Open-Source AI Agent OS inspired by OpenAI Dots, Meta Muse, OpenClaw, Hermes & Mem0. Autonomous 3-tier headhunting, Receipt & Verifier loops, scoped memory, and BYOM for Claude Code, Codex & Cursor.
summary: Desktop AI agent that hires a specialist for each task, works in your real apps for weeks, and takes orders from your phone. Free, Apache-2.0.
